title_en: Fall 2026 Research Student Registration for Those Past the Thesis Submission Deadline
summary: Graduate students who have completed coursework and exceeded the thesis submission deadline (master's: 4+2 years after completion; doctoral: 6+2 years after completion) may apply once to register as research students for Fall 2026. Applicants must submit the application form, confirmation and statement of reasons in Attachment 1 by Wednesday, 22 July 2026, either in person at the department office (Building 301, Room 319) or as a PDF by email. Approval is decided by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee, and approved students must submit their thesis within 3 years of approval.
applies_to: Graduate students who have completed coursework (수료) and have exceeded the thesis submission deadline: master's students more than 4+2 years after completion, and doctoral students more than 6+2 years after completion. The notice does not state that the application is mandatory; it is for those who wish to register as research students. Master's completers less than 6 years after completion and doctoral completers less than 8 years after completion must instead apply for a thesis submission deadline extension. A separate provision covers completers who were given a 2-year thesis submission opportunity before 1 March 2012 and seek an additional 1-year extension.

conditions: The application may be made only once.
Approval is decided by review of the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee.
Approved students must submit their thesis within 3 years of approval; if they fail to do so for personal reasons, no further opportunity will be given.

Master's completers less than 6 years after completion and doctoral completers less than 8 years after completion are not eligible here and must apply for a thesis submission deadline extension instead.
An approval email from the advisor may replace the advisor's signature, but it must be submitted together with the application.
Master's completers must register for at least 1 semester; doctoral completers must register for at least 2 semesters.
Tuition is charged at the rate for students exceeding the standard period of study: half tuition for 3 credits or fewer, full tuition for 4 credits or more.
Master's completers must earn at least 6 credits; doctoral completers must earn at least 9 credits.
Doctoral completers may not complete all 9 credits in one semester; however, after completing 9 credits they may complete 1 or more additional credits in the following semester.
Research students may take any course, including courses recommended by the advisor, courses helpful to their research, courses already taken, and thesis research.
Courses taken as a research student appear on the transcript but are not reflected in grades or GPA.
A previously passed thesis qualifying examination is recognised; those who failed must take it again.
Completers who were given a 2-year thesis submission opportunity before 1 March 2012, did not complete their thesis in time, and seek an additional 1-year extension must submit Attachment 2.
steps: Read Attachment 1 (application form, confirmation and statement of reasons); the attachment is an HWP file whose content was not read for this translation.

Check whether you have passed the thesis qualifying examination on Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험 신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험판정결과].
Complete one copy each of the application form, confirmation and statement of reasons from Attachment 1, with your advisor's signature or an approval email from your advisor.

Submit the documents (and the advisor's approval email, if used instead of a signature) by Wednesday, 22 July 2026, either in person at the department office (Building 301, Room 319) or as a PDF by email (the address is in the original notice).
If approved, register for courses during the enrolled students' course registration change period.
Pay tuition within the registration period (additional registration or final registration).

Complete the required semesters and credits (master's: at least 1 semester and 6 credits; doctoral: at least 2 semesters and 9 credits), retake the qualifying examination if you have not passed it, and submit your thesis within 3 years of approval.

Completers given a 2-year opportunity before 1 March 2012 seeking a 1-year extension: submit Attachment 2 (additional extension application form; the content of this HWP file was not read for this translation).
translation:
[Graduate School] Fall 2026 Application for Research Student Registration for Those Who Have Exceeded the Degree Thesis Submission Deadline (by 22 July)

1. Eligibility
- Those who have exceeded the thesis submission deadline (after completion of coursework: master's 4 years + 2 years, doctoral 6 years + 2 years)
※ The application may be made only once, and approval is decided through review by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee.
※ The degree thesis must be submitted within 3 years of approval. If you are approved this time and fail to submit your thesis due to personal circumstances, no further opportunity will be given.
※ Those less than 6 years after completing the master's program, or less than 8 years after completing the doctoral program, must apply for a 'thesis submission deadline extension' [학위논문제출기한 연장 신청].

2. Documents to Submit
- [Attachment 1] (Application for Research Student Registration for Those Who Have Exceeded the Thesis Submission Deadline, Confirmation, Statement of Reasons), one copy each

3. How to Submit the Application
- By Wednesday, 22 July 2026, submit to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) or submit a PDF file by email.
※ An approval email from the advisor may replace the advisor's signature; it must be submitted together with the application.

4. How to Complete the Program
A. Number of registrations: master's program, at least 1 semester; doctoral program, at least 2 semesters.
※ Tuition is paid at the rate for those registered beyond the standard period of study (= those exceeding the prescribed semesters): half tuition for 3 credits or fewer, full tuition for 4 credits or more.
B. Coursework: master's completers must earn at least 6 credits; doctoral completers must earn at least 9 credits.
※ For the doctoral program, it is not possible to complete all 9 credits in one semester. However, it is possible to complete the 9 credits and then complete 1 or more additional credits in the following semester.
※ Research students may take any course (e.g. courses recommended by the advisor, courses helpful to their research, courses already taken, thesis research, etc.).
※ Courses taken by research students appear on the transcript but are not reflected in grades or GPA.
C. Thesis qualifying examination: a previous pass may be recognised, but those who failed must take it again.
※ How to check whether you passed the qualifying examination: Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험 신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험판정결과]
D. Course registration period: course registration [수강신청] is possible during the 'enrolled students' course registration change period' [재학생 수강신청 변경기간].
E. Tuition payment period: pay within the registration period (additional registration, final registration).

5. Completers who were given a 2-year thesis submission opportunity before 1 March 2012 but did not complete their degree thesis within the deadline, and who wish to be approved for an additional 1-year extension, must submit [Attachment 2].

Inquiries: department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.
